relTest.notes: Easier screens on the computer: a short New project window (address, homeowner, dates, drop the claim's documents); Project details in steps with what's still missing for the phone and a Send to the phone button; Report sections show what's ready, the blanks to fill and the sections you write, one section at a time; the Report tab is grouped into Write, Share and Check; imported values are grouped with the differences first. Building permits: the finaled date is left out when it isn't found. Aerial photos are sorted by date, with Draw arrows. Pick-or-type lists in Project details. Delete a project from the computer.
